description.message: Loop any part of a YouTube video with A–B controls inside the player.

saveError.message: Could not save the points. Looping still works.

notReady.message: Wait for a regular video to load. Live streams are not supported.

invalidTime.message: Enter a time within the video, e.g. 1:25.500.

invalidRange.message: B must be at least 0.2 seconds after A.

initial.message: Set A at the start and B at the end of the section.

storageError.message: Storage is unavailable. You can still set points manually.

settingsSaved.message: Saved. Open YouTube tabs update automatically.
